caption:
Anthropic launched Claude Haiku 5.5 on October 7, a small model priced at $0.10 input and $0.50 output per million tokens for prompts up to 100,000 tokens, the same rates as OpenAI’s GPT-6 Luna.

Anthropic says it costs around 75% less to run than Haiku 4.5, though a new tokenizer uses slightly more tokens. Anthropic’s own benchmark table has Haiku 5.5 ahead of Luna on all six tests where both have scores. Kingy AI says the 72.4% OSWorld 2.1 score is partial credit, and the strict pass rate is 37.1%. Prompts longer than 100,000 tokens cost $0.50 input and $2.50 output.

Anthropic also cut Sonnet 5.5 cache-read prices from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens. A cache read is a discounted charge for reusing previously processed prompt content. Tokens are the chunks of text a model reads and writes.
